Definition: from G3708; gazed at, i.e. (by implication) capable of being seen:--visible.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, horatós means visible. It occurs just once, in Colossians.
TheologicalSignificance: I read horatós plainly: visible, and I leave it there.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
